title: Saturno
summary: A modern Laravel/Inertia monolith with a modular boundary for work management.
context: Saturno explores work organization for users, teams, and integrations without anticipating a distributed architecture.
constraints: Evolve a product without premature distributed complexity.
Separate architectural intent from proven capability.

decisions.title: Modern monolith
decisions.body: Laravel and Inertia keep delivery, domain, and operation close.

decisions.title: Selective DDD
decisions.body: WorkManagement gets a modular boundary where its vocabulary needs clarity.

decisions.title: Organizational isolation
decisions.body: Organization and authorization cross every use case, not only the interface.

evidence.label: Honest scope
evidence.detail: Queues, auditing, and portability are claimed only when proven.

limits: No adoption, scale, or production claim is made.
Queues, auditing, and portability stay outside the narrative until evidence exists.
License and source commit await audit.
